title: D-Day: The Crossing
hook: June 6th, 1944. The largest seaborne invasion in history began. Thousands of men would never come home.
style: Cinematic historical documentary; authentic 1944 U.S. Coast Guard colour film only
thematic_question: What did it take to open the door to Western Europe in June 1944?
footage_policy: Only NARA records with use status 'Unrestricted'. No AI visuals, reenactments, movie footage or stills. No shot labelled as Omaha Beach or 6 June.

music.note: User opted out: narration only, no music, no artificial sound effects.
